title: Cancellation, No-Show and Death Before Arrival under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement
content:
**Section 1 — How a booked stay closes before arrival.** A booked stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement may be cancelled by the guest's signed cancellation, signed by the guest or by a representative whose representative authority on the customer profile is financial power of attorney, durable power of attorney or guardian. A stay whose guest does not arrive on the planned arrival date is closed as a no-show. A stay whose guest dies before arrival is closed as guest deceased on the strength of the date of death on the customer profile. The signer's authority and the date of death are read from the customer profile of the guest, not from what a caller states.

**Section 2 — Reversal.** On every cancellation the planned-stay charge, and any extension charge, is reversed in full by a cancellation reversal credit referencing it. Cancellation credits may be posted only while the stay is in cancelled status.

**Section 3 — Free cancellation.** A cancellation carries no fee only if it is signed no later than the free-cancellation period of the stay type before the planned arrival. The free-cancellation deadline is the planned arrival date minus the free-cancellation period in calendar days, and a cancellation signed on that deadline date is still free.

**Section 4 — Fees.** A cancellation fee may be charged only when the cancellation is signed after the free-cancellation deadline before the planned arrival, which every no-show is. A guest cancellation signed after the deadline is charged the late-cancellation fee nights of the stay type times the locked nightly rate; a no-show is charged the no-show fee nights of the stay type times the locked nightly rate; a cancellation for a guest deceased is never charged. At most one cancellation fee is charged per stay, and any prepayment exceeding the fee is refunded under the refund terms.

## Fee by kind of closure

| Kind of closure | Signed or occurring | Cancellation fee |
|---|---|---|
| Guest cancellation | On or before the free-cancellation deadline | None |
| Guest cancellation | After the deadline, before the planned arrival | Late-cancellation fee nights times the locked nightly rate |
| No-show | On the planned arrival date | No-show fee nights times the locked nightly rate |
| Guest deceased | Any time before arrival | Never charged |

In every row the planned-stay charge and any extension charge are reversed in full, and no stay carries more than one cancellation fee.

## Deadline: boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

A hypothetical stay type with a free-cancellation period of 7 days and a planned arrival on 20 May has its free-cancellation deadline on 13 May.

| Cancellation signed by the guest | Relative to the deadline | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 13 May | On the deadline date | None — still free |
| 14 May | One day after the deadline | Late-cancellation fee |

## Worked figures (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) is locked at 329.00 a night, with a planned-stay segment of 7 nights, 2,303.00, and a prepayment of 2,303.00. The guest's daughter, holding a durable power of attorney on the profile, signs a cancellation after the deadline. The planned-stay segment of 2,303.00 is reversed by a cancellation reversal credit; the late-cancellation fee of the stay type, 2 nights, is 2 times 329.00, that is 658.00. The prepayment exceeds the fee by 2,303.00 less 658.00, that is 1,645.00, which is refunded under the refund terms.
